title: Tender chicken with carrots and peas
summary: Poached chicken thigh, shredded fine, with soft diced carrot and squashed peas: a simple, iron-rich plate.
texture: Finely shredded, moist chicken and small, soft vegetable pieces baby can pick up. Everything should squash between your fingers.
ingredients: 1 small carrot, peeled and diced small
steps: Put the chicken in a small pan with the water. Bring to a simmer, cover and poach for 15 to 18 minutes until cooked through (165°F / 74°C). Keep the cooking liquid.
Steam or boil the carrot for 10 minutes and the peas for 4 minutes, until very soft.
Shred the chicken very finely with two forks, discarding any fat or gristle. Moisten with a spoonful of the cooking liquid and the oil.
Flatten each pea with a fork. Serve the chicken and vegetables in small piles for baby to explore.
choking: Shred chicken into fine, moist strands. Chunks of meat are a choking risk.
Squash every pea: round foods can block a small airway.
storage: Fridge up to 2 days, or freeze up to 1 month. Reheat until steaming hot, then cool before serving.
tips: Thigh meat stays more tender and moist than breast meat, and has more iron.
Save the poaching liquid (no salt added) to moisten mashes.
